description: Provides financial assistance for constructing Krishi Hondas (farm ponds) to harvest rainwater. Promotes dryland agriculture.
eligibility: Farmers with dryland agriculture in Karnataka. Must have an Aadhaar card and RTC (Pani).
benefits: Subsidy up to 80% for farm ponds, diesel pumps, and micro-irrigation systems.
application_process: Apply at the nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or through the Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System (FRUITS) portal.

description: A central government scheme offering minimum income support to all landholding farmer families.
eligibility: All landholding farmers with cultivable land holding in their names.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to the bank account.
application_process: Register via the PM-KISAN portal online or visit the local Revenue Officer / Common Service Center (CSC).

description: Not a subsidy, but a crucial digital service allowing farmers to access their land records (RTC, Mutation) online.
benefits: Easy access to land documents required for bank loans and crop insurance.
application_process: Visit the Karnataka Bhoomi portal or Nada Kacheri.

scheme_name: Karnataka Raitha Suraksha Pradhana Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support in case of crop failure due to natural calamities, pests, or diseases.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Mandatory for loanee farmers.
benefits: Coverage for yield losses due to non-preventable risks. Premium is very low (e.g., 2% for Kharif crops).
application_process: Apply through banks, CSCs, or the PMFBY portal before the seasonal deadline.
